[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lip trills: This exercise involves blowing air through your lips while making a humming sound.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lip trills help to warm up your vocal cords and improve your breath support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vocal scales: Singing scales in different keys can help you strengthen your vocal muscles, improve your pitch accuracy, and increase your vocal range.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Descending glides: This exercise involves starting at a high pitch and sliding down to a low pitch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Descending glides help to improve your vocal control, especially when it comes to hitting high notes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Singing with a straw: Singing through a straw can help to focus your breath and improve your resonance.
